results.question: How many customers are there in each country? Show the country and the count, sorted by count (highest first), then by country name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, Country;

results.question: What is the total sales amount for each billing country, sorted from highest to lowest, then by country name?

results.question: What is the total of all invoices in the year 2010?

results.question: How many tracks belong to each genre? Show the genre name and the count, sorted by count (highest first), then by genre name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, g.Name;

SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC, g.Name;

results.question: What are the names and lengths (in milliseconds) of the 5 longest tracks? If lengths tie, sort by name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC, Name LIMIT 5;

FROM Track
ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC

results.question: Which artist has the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums.
results.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artists ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.Name LIMIT 1;
results.pred_sql:
SELECT a.Name, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfAlbums
FROM Album a
JOIN Artists ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
ORDER BY NumberOfAlbums DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent? Show first name, last name and total spent.
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.LastName, c.FirstName LIMIT 3;

FROM Customer c

results.question: What are the names of all customers who have bought at least one track from the 'Jazz' genre? Show each customer only once.
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY c.LastName, c.FirstName;
results.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';

results.question: Who are the top 3 artists by total revenue? Revenue is the sum of unit price × quantity from the invoice lines. Show the artist name and revenue.
results.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, ar.Name LIMIT 3;
results.pred_sql:
SELECT a.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM Album a
JOIN Track t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

results.question: What was the total sales amount for each month of the year 2011? Show the month and the total, in month order.
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2011-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
results.pred_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) AS TotalSales
FROM Invoice
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011'
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY Month;

results.pred_sql:

results.question: Which sales support agent (employee) is assigned to the most customers? Show their first name, last name and the number of customers.
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC, e.LastName, e.FirstName LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS NumberOfCustomers
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId

LIMIT 1;
